# Dithervatar

Deterministic dithered avatars from any string. The same string always renders the same avatar. WebGL2 Bayer halftone with a 2D canvas fallback, zero runtime dependencies, ESM only.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dithervatar
- repo: https://github.com/kirianL/Dithervatar
- license: MIT

## Install

```bash
npm install dithervatar
```

## Usage

```js
import { renderDithervatar } from 'dithervatar';

const canvas = document.querySelector('#avatar');
const cancel = renderDithervatar(canvas, {
  hash: '0x742d35cc6634c0532925a3b844bc454e4438f44e',
  size: 128,
  animated: false,
});
```

`renderDithervatar(canvas, options)` draws into the given `<canvas>` and returns a `cancel()` function that stops the animation loop.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hash` | `string` | `''` | Seed for colors, field offset and dither seeds. |
| `size` | `number` | `64` | Square canvas size in CSS pixels. |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `false` | Runs the dither loop with `requestAnimationFrame`. |
| `tones` | `string[]` | — | Palette override as hex, `oklch()` or CSS color names. |

## React

```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { renderDithervatar } from 'dithervatar';

export function Avatar({ hash, size = 64 }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => renderDithervatar(ref.current, { hash, size }), [hash, size]);
  return <canvas ref={ref} width={size} height={size} />;
}
```

## Constraints

- A canvas holds a single context type. If the element already has a 2d context, pass a fresh `<canvas>`.
- Use one canvas per avatar and call `cancel()` on unmount or when the hash changes.
- The canvas is square and transparent-friendly. Clip with `border-radius` for circles or squircles.
- WebGL2 is used when available; otherwise the 2D renderer takes over automatically.

## Other exports

`hashToColors`, `hashToSeeds`, `oklchToHex`, `oklchToCss`, `parseTone`, `hasWebGL2`, `renderDitherGL`, `renderDithervatarTo`.
